The HSTF is a permanent, interagency law enforcement task force created by executive order to combat transnational criminal organizations—including cartels, trafficking networks, and foreign terrorist organizations. This current source item can be tested against the underlying record and connected to the relevant evidence lane.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
